note: STREET GAME (https://street-game.centro-datos-crudo.workers.dev/) is capture-class: a Vite production build of the Spanish-language 3D street-marbles game served at the origin root by Cloudflare Workers. §0.4 fork-over-mirror was checked on 2026-10-12 — neither the page nor its JS references a public source repo (zero github.com/gitlab.com references in the capture; the credits point to the X account @IAenCrudo, and GitHub searches for the project find nothing), so the mirror stands. Derived pipeline: capture → pinned prettier 3.9.6 (module API, default options, single pass verified idempotent — never the CLI: it respects .gitignore and can silently echo its input) → readable/<name>.pretty.js|css per captured JS/CSS file (capture-root-relative name, nested dirs flattened with __; every pretty provably NOT byte-identical to its capture source) → statement-aligned slices src/<name>-NN.js of the app code (top-level declaration boundaries only, ~250-350 line windows; oversized single declarations stay whole) with an exact 2-line provenance header. Every slice parses standalone under `node --input-type=module --check -` and round-trips byte-exact to its recorded readable line range. Vendor rule — wholeFile sections, never sliced: the Vite modulepreload polyfill opening the bundle, the bundled three.js core (everything before the WebGLRenderer declaration, incl. the __THREE__ revision registration, geometries, materials and ShaderLib) and the bundled three.js WebGLRenderer implementation. The minifier merged the app's level-config declarators (q, cl, ll, ul, dl, fl, pl, ml, hl, gl, _l, vl) into the SAME top-level VariableDeclaration as the WebGLRenderer class (`var sl = class {…}, q = {…}, …`): the `sl` class declarator is the renderer-vendor wholeFile region, the app declarators are one explicit ranged slice whose body is the exact declarator list text (a syntactically standalone comma-chain of assignments, byte-exact against its readable range). Stylesheet rule — assets/index-BM9TqdBo.css is wholeFile. Media/font/image payloads are notRendered records (bytes + sha256, no pretty pass). Inline <script>/<style> scan: index.html references external chunks only — zero inline content blocks, so there are no *-inline-N twins and no index-inline-map.json. Identifiers in src/ are the bundle's own minified names — the rename campaign (PLAN §5) is recorded as an open task in README.md, not claimed here. Capture bytes are untouched by everything above; re-cut with `node tools/derive.mjs` after any capture refresh. `node tools/audit.js` is the gate.
